about.title: About us
about.intro: prepza helps companies find people who really know the job: a fair, timed interview made from your job description, at a price any team can afford. And anyone preparing for an interview can practise for free.
about.description: prepza turns a job description into a fair, timed interview in minutes, at a price any team can afford, and lets anyone practise for interviews for free.

company.title: Why we exist
company.problem: Hiring often rests on a CV and a good conversation, and both can mislead. The assessment tools that help are priced for big companies, with annual plans and seat fees, so most teams go without.
company.approach: prepza turns a job description into a timed interview in minutes, for any role. Every candidate gets their own questions, you see who knows the job and why, and you pay only for candidates who actually take it.
company.practice: We also want preparing for an interview to be free for everyone. Anyone can take our practice interviews for a role, see their grade and every right answer, and practise again, at no cost.

founder.quote: Hiring well shouldn't be a privilege of big companies with big budgets. I built prepza so that any team can turn a job description into a fair interview in minutes, see who really knows the job, and pay only for the candidates who take it. I hope it helps you find the right people faster.

landing.title: How prepza works
landing.text: prepza turns your job description into a timed multiple-choice interview, with its own random questions for every candidate.
actions: Paste the job description: prepza proposes the topics to test.
Review the topics: keep, edit or drop them, then approve to write the questions.
Invite candidates by email, from a file or with one shareable link.
Read the reports: candidates ranked by grade, with every answer and integrity flags.
tips: Creating interviews is free. You pay $1–3 per candidate who answers, and your first candidates are free.
Try your interview as a candidate before you invite anyone.

companies.title: Companies
companies.text: Your companies. Everything you do in prepza happens inside one: its interviews, candidates, team, credits and integrations.
actions: Create a company with “new company”. Its name is unique across prepza.
Open a company to work on its interviews and candidates.
Remove a company you own, with all its interviews and invites.
tips: Your role shows beside each company you don't own: admins change things, viewers only look.
Credits belong to a company, so each one tops up on its own.

pickCompany.title: Choose a company
pickCompany.text: You picked a template. Choose the company it's for: the template is copied there as a new interview, free and ready to send to candidates.
actions: Pick a company to open the template in it, then use it.
Create a new company if you don't have one yet; the template opens there.
tips: Once copied, the interview is the company's own: change its questions and settings as you like.

interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.text: All of this company's interviews and its credits for candidates. Each interview is a timed test made from a job description.
actions: Create an interview from a job description with “new interview”.
Open an interview to see its topics, candidates and settings.
Try an interview as a candidate, or delete it.
Top up credits, or turn on automatic top-ups, from the balance.
tips: The balance turns amber when credits run low. Without credits, new invites aren't sent.
The tabs above lead to templates, your team, integrations and referrals.

newInterview.title: New interview
newInterview.text: Start an interview from the job description. prepza reads it, proposes the topics to test, and writes the questions once you approve them.
actions: Paste the job description: the role, its requirements and nice-to-haves.
Choose the language to generate the interview in.
Generate, then review the proposed topics.
tips: The more specific the description, the closer the questions fit the role.
Generating is free: you pay only for candidates who answer.

reviewTopics.title: Review your topics
reviewTopics.text: prepza proposed these topics from your description. Each topic you keep gets its own set of questions with answers.
actions: Uncheck the topics you don't need.
Edit a topic's name and subtopics with its pencil.
Describe changes in your own words and apply them, for example “add a topic on team leadership”.
Approve and generate to write the questions.
tips: With too many topics, uncheck some or describe how to merge them.
Questions are written only after you approve, so take a minute here.

generating.title: Generating
generating.text: prepza is making your interview: first the topics, then the questions for each one. It takes a few minutes.
actions: Leave this page if you like: generation keeps going.
Cancel the generation if you no longer need it; nothing made so far is kept.
tips: You get a notification when the interview is ready.
Come back any time from the interviews list.

interviewTopics.title: Topics
interviewTopics.text: What this interview tests: its topics, each with subtopics and its own pool of questions. Every candidate gets a random set from each pool.
actions: Open “manage questions” to read a topic's questions and answers.
Re-generate a weak question, mark a wrong answer, or read candidates' reports on a question.
Set how many questions each candidate gets from a topic.
Try the interview as a candidate, or delete it.
tips: AI-written questions can be wrong: skim each topic before you invite anyone.
Click the title to rename the interview.

interviewCandidates.title: Candidates
interviewCandidates.text: Everyone invited to this interview, with their status, progress and grade.
actions: Invite candidates: one at a time, a list of up to 100, or a CSV or TXT file.
Turn on the shareable link for a job ad: anyone with it can take the interview.
Search by email or name, filter by status, and sort by grade or date.
Open a candidate's report, or download or share the report on all candidates.
tips: Each candidate who answers at least one question uses credits, including those from the link.
Reminders go to candidates automatically.

interviewSettings.title: Settings
interviewSettings.text: How this interview runs for every candidate.
actions: Set the time each question has, in seconds.
Set the passing grade: candidates who reach it pass.
Mark the interview as hired once you've filled the role.
tips: Each setting saves as soon as you leave its field.
Candidates never see their scores; only your team does.
For one candidate who needs more time, add extra time on their page.

tryInterview.title: Try as a candidate
tryInterview.text: A preview of this interview just as candidates see it: the intro, then the timed questions. It's free.
actions: Start the preview and answer as a candidate would.
Check the timing, the wording and the answers before you invite anyone.
tips: Stay on the page while you answer: for candidates, leaving the page, copying and answering too fast are recorded.

candidate.title: Candidate report
candidate.text: One candidate's results: their grade, whether they passed, and each topic's score with every answer.
actions: Read each answer, with integrity flags: page leaves, copy attempts and fast answers.
Download the report as a PDF, or share it by email.
Give extra time before they start, for example for a disability.
Add or edit the candidate's name.
Resend or revoke the invite, or delete the candidate with their results.
tips: The score supports your decision; it doesn't make it. If the candidate asks, have a person review their result.

templates.title: Templates
templates.text: Ready-made interviews for common roles. Using one copies it into this company as your own interview.
actions: Search by role or topic, and filter by level and language.
Open a template to see its topics and how many questions each has.
Use a template to start an interview from it.
tips: For a closer fit, create an interview from your own job description instead.
Once copied, the interview is yours: change its questions and settings as you like.

template.title: Template
template.text: A ready-made interview: its topics, their subtopics and how many questions each topic has.
actions: Check that the topics match the role you're hiring for.
Use the template to copy it into this company as a new interview.
tips: Copying is free; candidates who answer use credits as usual.
If the topics don't fit, create an interview from your job description instead.

team.title: Team
team.text: The people who work on this company's interviews, and their roles.
actions: Add a member by email, as an admin or a viewer.
Change a member's role between admin and viewer.
Copy a pending invite's link, or remove a member or an invite.
tips: Admins create and change interviews, invite candidates and top up. Viewers see interviews and results and share reports, but change nothing.
Removing a member whose card pays for automatic top-ups stops those top-ups.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.text: Connect prepza to the tools your team already uses. Each integration opens its own page with setup steps.
actions: Slack: get your company's notifications in a channel.
ATS (Workable, Greenhouse, Teamtailor, Recruitee, Breezy HR): candidates you move to a stage get the interview, and their results go back.
API: keys and web hooks to connect your own platform.
tips: Everyone in the company sees the integrations; owners and admins change them.

ats.title: ATS integration
ats.text: Link a job in your ATS to an interview: candidates you move into a chosen stage get the interview, and their results come back as a comment on their profile.
actions: Connect your ATS by following its instructions.
Link a job: choose the job, its stage and an interview, or make a new interview from the job's text.
Invite again candidates who weren't invited, for example when credits ran out.
Unlink a job, or disconnect the ATS.
tips: Add a stage just for prepza, like “prepza skills test”, so it never mixes with your other tools.
prepza never moves or rejects anyone in your ATS.

slack.title: Slack
slack.text: Your company's notifications in a Slack channel, as they happen.
actions: Add prepza to Slack and pick the channel, for example #hiring.
Choose which notifications go there: a candidate finishing, an invite that wasn't delivered, an interview being ready and more.
Disconnect to stop them and remove prepza's app from your Slack.
tips: prepza can only post to that channel; it can't read your Slack.
Everyone still sees every notification in the bell.

api.title: API
api.text: Connect your own platform, such as your careers site, to prepza.
actions: Create an API key: it reads your interviews and candidates and invites candidates as you.
Add a web hook: when a candidate finishes, their results go to your HTTPS address, signed.
Delete the keys and web hooks you no longer use.
Open the API docs for every endpoint and event.
tips: A new key and a web hook's secret show only once: copy them right away.
Choose an expiry for each key: a leaked key that never expires stays usable.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.text: Invite other companies to prepza with this company's link, and you both earn credits.
actions: Copy or share your referral link.
See every reward this company has received.
tips: You both get credits when the company you invited makes its first top-up, of any amount.
Credits go to this company and never expire.
